title: The Cage Takes Live Model Traffic: Deterministic Refusal of Model Drift Against a Derived Expectation (DRIFT-RPT-03)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE, READ FIRST: AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Errors are disclosed, not erased. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. Not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All payloads synthetic. No customer-identifiable data appears in this record (POL-DISC-001).

A deterministic containment gate, asked to judge model output it had never seen. The gate derives what a correct decision record must contain from a roster and a stream, then requires exact conformance: schema, field order, types, content, length. It does not evaluate reasoning and does not ask a second model. Anything not exactly conformant is refused, and every decision, refused or accepted, writes an audit row with the gate's own reason string.

Why this run existed. Between 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-30 the deployed gate received no new model input. In that silence it had lost enforcement of one column: a TypeScript port replaced a whole-record comparison with a per-key loop whose lower bound was written as 1 instead of 0, and the first key was position, the field that ties a decision to the record it acts on. A frozen negative corpus caught it on replay, the fix was one line in both gates, and the patched gate then refused 10 of 10 with an error string character-identical to the frozen reference. Full finding in the prior record.

What is new here is live traffic. Four decisions: a frozen positive control replayed before any leg (accepted, 12 decisions), then three legs generated by fresh live model instances from a specification, with no access to the gate source or the expected answer. Three different framings were the experimental variable: specification stated in full, specification thin, and the same thin specification under deadline pressure.

Result: one acceptance, two refusals, no leaks. The spec-stated leg produced a byte-conformant report and was accepted. The thin and pressure legs were both refused on content. The audit trail for the series now stands at 59 recorded decisions, 38 refused and 21 accepted, the acceptances being controls, preflights and post-fix verifications rather than catches.

The drift classes are the substance. Both refused legs wrote the playbook code (PB-003) where the gate expects the roster record identifier, which is the same provenance column the port had lost. One paraphrased the canonical steps string into a prose description of the same procedure. The pressure leg did not overstate completion: it invented two status values that exist in no version of the schema and applied one to 11 of 12 records, producing output that reads as a clean sheet and parses as nothing. Under the thin framing the model also resolved two below-threshold records (0.799999 against 0.8, 0.849999 against 0.85), having been given no threshold rule; given the rule, it held both.

Two independent faults, one column. A port drifted from its reference and a model drifted from its specification, and both landed on the join key. That convergence is the report's central observation: a provenance field is the easiest thing to lose and the most expensive, because everything downstream assumes it and nothing downstream can detect its absence.

Scope caveats, load-bearing. All three legs were generated by the same model family as the agent operating the gate; this is not a benchmark of any named external engine and must not be cited as one. Every leg ran validate_only: no synthetic target mutated, no healing action executed, and production write-path enforcement remains unverified beyond recorded preflight legs. Three framings and twelve stream records are a sample, not a bound. Prompt framings are frozen and hashed so the experiment can be replayed byte for byte.

Cadence. The gap was never capability, it was cadence. The leg is now scheduled weekly, silent unless behaviour inverts (a deviating leg accepted, or the spec-stated leg refused), because a gate nobody pushes on is not a gate that holds.
